page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a narrow column of year dates (A. C.) runs down the right margin beside the text. Running head at top. Centred division heading "SECULUM OCTAVUM." with subheading "§. XLV. — L." above the text. Catchword "Ca-" at the lower right.

main_text.p: Benedictus II. P. impetrat, ut Papa non expectato consensu Imperatoris vel Exarchi confirmetur. ibid.685.
Sergius I. P. in schismate ex media populi turba raptus Papa salutatur. ibid.688.

Constantinopoli celebrata Synodus Quinisexta, varios canones Ecclesiae Romanae disciplinae & authoritati opponit. Unde repugnante Ecclesia R. schisma Orientales inter & Occidentales invalescit §. XLIV.692.
main_text.head: SECULUM OCTAVUM.
§. XLV. — L.
main_text.p: Seculi octavi status proferendae Ecclesiae Romanae dominationi per opportunus est §. XLV.701.
Aripertus Longobardorum Rex Johanni VII. P. Alpes Cottias donat.705.
Justinianus II. Imp. missis Johanni VII. actis Synodi Sextae, frustra Orientalis & Occidentalis Ecclesiae reconciliationem tentat. ibid.
Constantinus P. a Justiniano Constantinopolin vocatur, colloquio cum ipso instituendo finem controversiae de Synodo sexta impositurus. Muneribusque onustum, re infecta remittit. ibid.708.

Philippicus Bardanes Imp. & Johannes Patr. Const. Patrum Concilii VI. imagines e porticu Sophiae removent. Eandem Constantinus P. Romae in porticu S. Petri collocat, definiens insuper, imagines in Templa inferendas esse. §. XLVI.712.

Leo III. Isaurus contra imagines edictum promulgat. adversus quem Gregorius II. Ravennates, Venetos, populumque omnem concitat. Unde populus in Paulum, Ravennae Exarchum, involans, universam Italiam caedibus implet; tandemque Romani ab Imp. Orientali & Exarcho ejus defciscunt. ibid.726.
Zacharias P. abdicato Hilderico, Francorum Rege, ceu stupido, Regnum Pipino, Majori domus, tradit. ibid.752.
Constantino Copronymo Imp. Constantinopoli celebratur Concilium VII. quo, explosis imaginibus, definitur, unicam esse imaginem a Christo institutam, Eucharistiam scilicet. §. XLVII.754.
Nicaeae, annitentibus Irene & Hadriano I. P. celebratur Synodus Nicaena II. qua sancitur, imagines honorandas, venerandas, salutandas, osculandas, incensis, cereis prosequendas esse. ibid.787.

page.notes: Right margin holds year dates (A. C.) beside the paragraphs; the header "A. C." is printed at top right. Some letters in the scan are faint (e.g. "Ravennæ", "Synodus"); the marginal figure "708" at the Constantinus paragraph was read from a faint print and may be doubtful. Left page is not present on this scan.
